items.title: 6.12.1 Calculating ΔG° for a reaction (ΔG° ka hisab) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 6.12.1, printed pages 139-140, with both sample problems worked.

blocks.title: Sample Problem 6.12
blocks.problem:
Is reaction ke liye:
CaSO₄(s) → Ca²⁺(aq) + SO₄²⁻(aq)
25 °C par ΔH°, ΔS° aur ΔG° nikalein aur batayein ke reaction spontaneous hai ya nahi.
Heat of formation: CaSO₄(s) = –1432.7 kJ, Ca²⁺(aq) = –543.0 kJ, SO₄²⁻(aq) = –907.5 kJ
Standard entropy: CaSO₄(s) = 106.7 J/K, Ca²⁺(aq) = –55.2 J/K, SO₄²⁻(aq) = +17.2 J/K
steps: J ko kJ mein badlein (1000 se divide): ΔS° = –0.1447 kJ/K
blocks.answer: ΔG° positive hai, is liye 25 °C par standard conditions mein yeh process spontaneous nahi (CaSO₄ khud ba khud poora nahi ghulta).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne ΔS° ki line mein '–1447 J/K' chhapa hai; sahi –144.7 J/K hai (decimal chhoot gaya). Kitab agli line mein khud –0.1447 kJ/K leti hai, is liye ΔG° = +25.3 kJ sahi hai.

blocks.title: Sample Problem 6.13
blocks.problem:
Haber process ke is reaction ka 25 °C par standard free energy change, ΔG°, kitna hai? Spontaneity bhi batayein.
N₂(g) + 3 H₂(g) → 2 NH₃(g)
Heat of formation: N₂(g) = 0 kJ, H₂(g) = 0 kJ, NH₃(g) = –45.9 kJ
Standard entropy: N₂(g) = 191.5 J/K, H₂(g) = 130.6 J/K, NH₃(g) = +193 J/K
steps: ΔH° = [2 × (–45.9)] – [0 + 0] = –91.8 kJ (elements N₂ aur H₂ ki ΔHf zero hai)
blocks.answer: ΔG° negative hai, is liye Haber process 25 °C par standard conditions mein spontaneous hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne ΔG° ki line mein ΔH° ko '–91.88 kJ' likha hai; oopar ΔH° = –91.8 kJ nikla tha, wahi istemal hona chahiye. Jawab –33.1 kJ sahi hai.

blocks.prompt: Dono reactions exothermic hain aur dono ki entropy change negative hai. Phir ek spontaneous aur doosra nahi, kyun?
blocks.explanation: Jab ΔH aur ΔS dono negative hon to ΔG tabhi negative hota hai jab TΔS ka hissa ΔH se chhota ho. Haber process: 298 × 0.197 = 58.7 kJ, jo 91.8 se kam hai, to ΔG negative. CaSO₄: 298 × 0.1447 = 43.1 kJ, jo 17.8 se zyada hai, to ΔG positive.

items: ΔG° = ΔH° – TΔS°; ΔH° heats of formation se, ΔS° standard entropies se (J ko kJ mein badlein, T kelvin mein).
CaSO₄ ghulna: ΔG° = +25.3 kJ, spontaneous nahi. Haber process: ΔG° = –33.1 kJ, 25 °C par spontaneous.
